liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Victim or the Crime** (2 reviews): Phil's intro features a massive bass bomb, considered the best ever; The intro is praised as haunting and beautiful by the listener [17][20]
- **Desolation Row** (1 review): The performance is described as nice, while the first set is generally solid [20]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Garcia's performance is highlighted as possibly the best of the year [17]

## The recordings

- **gd93-06-15.sbd.gardner.10085.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 184 min; rated 3.94/5 by 17 [1]. Said about its sound: The band plays tightly, with Vince's mix kept low to avoid cheesy tones; Althea and Estimated Prophet were skipped during streaming playback for this listener [16][23]
- **gd93-06-15.brennecke-young.georges.18984.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 144 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [5]
- **gd1993-06-15.fob.st250.young-brennecke.footbear.fix.99146.flac16**: source not stated; 16 songs; 143 min [10]. Said about its sound: A 16-second rogue radio station announcement track was removed from the original fileset [10]
- **gd1993-06-15.137863.mtx.jeh.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 16 songs; 145 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [2]

## Around the show

- Honda Goldwing convention attendees crowded the area near the outdoor stadium and amusement park [12]
- A cotton candy vendor moved near the front row, distracting Jerry during Crazy Fingers [13]
- A motorcycle convention and amusement rides, including a ferris wheel, were nearby [18]
- A roller coaster performing loops was visible right next to the parking lot [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-06-15.sbd.gardner.10085.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT>C>DAT>CDR [1]. Also: Soundboard source transferred via Paul and seeded to etree by Tony G [1]
- **gd93-06-15.brennecke-young.georges.18984.sbeok.shnf**: taped by James Young and Clay Brennecke; transferred by Nick Georges; source: Audience: Soundfield ST-250 (blumlein) [5]
- **gd1993-06-15.fob.st250.young-brennecke.footbear.fix.99146.flac16**: taped by James Young and Clay Brennecke; transferred by Footbear; source: FOB/DFC Soundfield ST-250 (blumlein mode) > Sony D10-Pro II (48k) hand held for set one, on stand (6') for 2nd set [10]
- **gd1993-06-15.137863.mtx.jeh.flac1648**: transferred by Matrix by jeh; source: flac16/48kHz ; Matrix Source 1 (shnid 137334): Recording Info: SBD > Dat Master (Panasonic SV-3700/48k); Transfer Info: Dat Master (Sony R500) > Sound Devices… [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1993-06-15 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1993-06-15-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [25]
